record.title: Bind the worker-access checker to the compiled 32-bit instruction
record.intent: Correct the witnessed checker expectation while retaining the native experiment unchanged.
requirements: Preserve both earlier attempts and manifests. The second attempt remains a partial result with seven accepted arms and a frozen checker rejection on arm108.

Correct only the arm108 worker opcode expectation from the compiled ELF evidence. Retain thread identity, PC, mapped address, rejection-before-modeling and cleanup checks. Do not weaken inherited or other sequence checks.

Use independent copies of actual run02 evidence to replay accepted arms101..107 and arm108 under the corrected checker. Exercise targeted changed-opcode, leader-substitution, changed-address and cleanup corruptions on arm108. Bind the worker symbol and opcode to the unchanged compiled image.

Preserve native executable SHA256 960b91e1b3cd7de8f49d47833c6e13ec43afcc597bb0d205c379f471a2bcda37 and profile SHA256 1fd5ffcf09094da41bd7aa08ed60974b6a6f4c3be9ba7f0f92eebdab087d8abb. No observer or synthetic response change.
Freeze private-adc-sequence-03 with the corrected verifier and the same twelve arms. Commit and push the new manifest and offline control conclusions before guest execution.
acceptance: A compiled-image-grounded checker correction and a separately frozen private suite are verified and pushed, or a precise limitation is recorded.
